user.title: Connect to your charging network
user.description: Paste any link from your charging network's web app (for example {example}).

data.api_base: API base URL (only if setup can't work it out)

settings.title: Charging settings
settings.description: Set the target energy to your vehicle's usable battery capacity so the session isn't cut short. Charging starts when the cable sensor turns on while the vehicle is within the radius of {location}. Pick a zone only if you want to define the area yourself, or if your tracker has no GPS position.

data.notify_service: Notify action or entity (app, email, Telegram, ...)

data_description.window_start: Usually not needed. Recommended instead: leave both empty, pay when you plug in, and set scheduled charging in the vehicle to the off-peak time. The session stays open and the vehicle draws power only from then on. Use these hours only if your vehicle can't delay charging; the start then waits until this time, and any payment is requested then.
data_description.window_end: A session that has started keeps running past this time.
data_description.wake_button: For vehicles whose integration doesn't update while the car sleeps, such as Tesla Fleet (its Wake button). Pressed when the charger reports a plug-in, so the car's location and cable status update within a minute instead of at the next poll. Waking the car may count against your vehicle API usage.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter your password
reauth_confirm.description: ScaleEV rejected the saved password for {email}.

error.invalid_link: That doesn't look like a link.
error.api_base_required: This network's API address couldn't be guessed, please enter it.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach ScaleEV or find that network.
error.zone_required: ScaleEV has no coordinates for this location, so choose a zone.
error.window_incomplete: Set both times, or leave both empty.
error.window_empty: The two times must be different.

abort.already_configured: This station is already set up for this account.
abort.no_locations: No charging locations are available for this account.
abort.no_stations: No stations found at that location.
